headline: Core contracts verified on Etherscan with two recognized-firm audits from 2022, but no confirmed follow-up audit covering post-2022 market deployments and implementation upgrades
short_headline: Verified; 2022 audits stale vs. current deploy

findings.text: Ethereum cUSDCv3 proxy (0xc3d688B66703497DAA19211EEdff47f25384cdc3) is a TransparentUpgradeableProxy with ABI source 'etherscan' (verified). Implementation (0xFe36A00669bB4b5834A2F3E2b9A2908fEe21d141) also has ABI source 'etherscan' (verified separately). Both proxy and implementation are independently verified on Etherscan.

Public GitHub repo confirmed at https://github.com/compound-finance/comet (Compound III / Comet). The OpenZeppelin audit pinned commit 0f1221967149115f50a09681eea9580879ee7720; no deployed-addresses JSON was fetched in this run to match that commit to the currently deployed implementation, so commit-match is recorded as a scope limit in unknowns.

Two audits of Compound III (Comet) are listed on docs.compound.finance: (1) OpenZeppelin Compound III Audit, delivered June 14, 2022, scoping the compound-finance/comet repo at commit 0f1221967149115f50a09681eea9580879ee7720; (2) ChainSecurity Compound Comet Audit, dated May 30, 2022. Both audits predate the current analysis date (2026-05-07) by approximately 4 years. Multiple additional markets and chains have been deployed since 2022 (Arbitrum, Base, Optimism, Polygon, Mantle, Linea, Ronin, Scroll, Unichain), and no confirmed follow-up audit covering post-2022 implementation versions was found in this run.
Both auditors — OpenZeppelin and ChainSecurity — are on the recognized firms list. OpenZeppelin is Compound's ongoing security partner per their published security policies.

The audits from May/June 2022 cover the initial Comet codebase. The protocol docs (last updated 2026-02-28) list deployments across 9 chains with many markets added post-2022. No specific differential audit or follow-up review covering currently deployed implementations was confirmed in this run. This constitutes stale audit scope relative to current deployments under the >6-month drift rule.

Proxy (0xc3d688B66703497DAA19211EEdff47f25384cdc3) resolves to implementation (0xFe36A00669bB4b5834A2F3E2b9A2908fEe21d141). Both are verified on Etherscan per defipunkd ABI-source fields. No unverified implementation gap detected for the Ethereum cUSDCv3 market.

steelman.red: If the deployed implementations across 9+ chains since 2022 contain material changes to fund-custody logic (new collateral accounting, modified access control) that were never re-audited by a recognized firm, the effective audit coverage is close to zero for current deployments, warranting a red grade.
steelman.orange: Both proxy and implementation are verified on Etherscan, the GitHub repo is public and clearly corresponds to the protocol, and two recognized-firm audits (OpenZeppelin and ChainSecurity) cover the initial Comet codebase — but those audits are ~4 years old and no confirmed follow-up audit covering post-2022 chain expansions or implementation upgrades was found in this run, making audit scope stale relative to current deployments.
steelman.green: OpenZeppelin is Compound's ongoing security partner and their published security policies state all contracts are audited prior to deployment; if continuous audit coverage exists for each new market/implementation, the protocol could merit green — but this run found no specific audit report URLs beyond the 2022 documents.

rationale.verdict: Choosing orange because both proxy and implementation are verified on Etherscan, the public source repo (compound-finance/comet) exists and was confirmed, and two recognized-firm audits (OpenZeppelin June 2022, ChainSecurity May 2022) cover the Comet codebase. However, the audits predate the current analysis by ~4 years and cover only the initial deployment commit; multiple new markets and chain deployments have occurred since 2022 without a confirmed follow-up audit in this run, placing audit scope as stale under the >6-month drift rule. The steelman for green relies on unverified continuous audit coverage, while the steelman for red requires confirmed material unaudited changes — neither was established in this run, so orange is the best-supported grade.

evidence.shows: Ethereum cUSDCv3 proxy is a TransparentUpgradeableProxy with ABI source 'etherscan' (verified on Etherscan). Proxy resolves to implementation 0xFe36A00669bB4b5834A2F3E2b9A2908fEe21d141.
Ethereum cUSDCv3 implementation contract has ABI source 'etherscan' (verified separately on Etherscan). Contains full Comet view-method ABI confirming it is the fund-custody lending logic contract.

Compound III docs list two audits: (1) OpenZeppelin Compound III Audit and (2) ChainSecurity Compound III Security Audit. Protocol uses OpenZeppelin TransparentUpgradeableProxy pattern. Docs updated 2026-02-28 list deployments across Ethereum, Arbitrum, Base, Optimism, Polygon, and other chains.
OpenZeppelin Compound III audit delivered June 14, 2022. Scoped compound-finance/comet repository at commit 0f1221967149115f50a09681eea9580879ee7720. Auditor: OpenZeppelin (recognized firm).

ChainSecurity public code assessment of Comet smart contracts dated May 30, 2022. Auditor: ChainSecurity (recognized firm). Notes that Comet contracts are deployed using OpenZeppelin's TransparentUpgradeableProxy with ProxyAdmin.
Public GitHub repository for Compound III (Comet) — 'An efficient money market protocol for Ethereum and compatible chains (aka Compound III, Compound v3)'. This is the canonical source repo.

unknowns: V2: Deployed-commit SHA for currently active implementation (0xFe36A00669bB4b5834A2F3E2b9A2908fEe21d141) not pinned in this run — no deployed-addresses JSON was fetched to match the live bytecode to a specific repo commit; local bytecode diff not performed.

V3: No confirmed follow-up or differential audit report covering post-2022 market deployments or implementation upgrades on Ethereum or other chains (Arbitrum, Base, Optimism, Polygon, Mantle, Linea, Ronin, Scroll, Unichain) found in this run. OpenZeppelin security partnership may cover continuous audits but no specific report URLs were confirmed.

V1-offchain: On-chain ABI reads for non-Ethereum chains (Mantle, Ronin) not supported by the defipunkd read API; bytecode verification status on those chains' block explorers not confirmed in this run.

protocol_metadata.about: Compound III (Comet) is a lending protocol where users supply crypto assets as collateral to borrow a single base asset (e.g., USDC, USDT, WETH) per market instance. Each market is deployed as an OpenZeppelin TransparentUpgradeableProxy backed by a Comet implementation contract, with protocol parameters managed via a Configurator contract and upgrades controlled by on-chain governance. The protocol operates across Ethereum, Arbitrum, Base, Optimism, Polygon, Mantle, Linea, Ronin, Scroll, and Unichain, with rewards distributed to suppliers and borrowers via a separate CometRewards contract.
